added.name: Fire Wallet
added.long_description:
🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA

TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal.

Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet!

🔥Why we built this

Most wallets and payment processors don’t work FOR you. They're slow, route your payments in the way that earns them the most, and they leak your financial life to anyone asking. Worse: every single one hold the keys to your money.

We believe your financial tools should act in your interest and, frankly, that your money should be yours.

 🔥What Fire does

Multi-chain, non-custodial, end-to-end encrypted wallet. 
Your keys, your money, your assets: you are in full control of your funds at all times. 
Least Cost Routing. Every swap and payment takes the cheapest path, not the one that pays a middleman the most.
Self-sovereign payment processing. Send an invoice straight from the wallet. Get paid from your web checkout. No middleman.
Easy fiat on/off ramps. Move stablecoins to USD and back without the pain.
Built for agentic commerce. Manage per-agent sub-wallets for agentic workflows.
Encrypted by default. Protecting you from bad actors and surveillance capitalism.

🔥Early traction

Signed our first major LOI with @Trustboop (founded by Justice Laub of Drone Racing League and Rob Rhinehart of Soylent).

Onboarding our first enterprise customer in ecommerce packaging and marketing, doing about $1.5M/month in volume. They've connected us to 10 more companies in the same vertical at similar volume, roughly a $100M/yr GMV opportunity.

🔥Why us

Josh and Manuel led the creation of MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency in Signal Messenger: $100M+ raised, $1.16B peak valuation, $4B+ peak coin market cap, acquired in 2026.

Michael runs product and design. He's an internationally exhibited artist with two published art books, and he builds sick products.

Manuel runs operations and orchestrates systems that actually work at scale.

🔥Asks

Intros to businesses moving $1M+/month in payments, especially cross-border, ecommerce, and DTC, who want lower fees and more control over their funds.

Strategic partners in fintech and payments interested in integrating our infrastructure.
Tell us what's broken. Reply here or email founders@fire.co.

We're looking for our first 100 customers. If that's you or someone you know, we'd love to talk.
added.one_liner: Fire Wallet is a privacy-first crypto wallet designed to just work,…

added.name: Tilo
added.long_description:
Tilo is a Linux-based operating system built for AI agents to work alongside people. On Tilo, computer use is up to 15x cheaper than on a normal OS.

Today agents use computers the way people do. They take screenshots and click through apps, which is slow, expensive, and brittle. In Tilo, every app exports actions, so agents work over MCP while people use the UI. You still see what each agent does in your apps, and anything it changes can be undone.

Any number of people and agents can work in one workspace in real time, across apps. Tilo runs as your OS, in our cloud, or headless on your machine, and you can open and share any workspace from the browser.

long_description.before:
Ben and Jacob met in Calculus class in 10th grade, and tried founding a startup in high school — it didn’t go anywhere.

During high school, Ben lead the frontend team for the World Health Organization’s COVID-19 App Team.

After high school, Jacob went to Apple and Ben went to college. When there was an opening on his team, Jacob had Ben apply, and Ben left UChicago to go work at Apple.

They spent about 2 years at Apple as Senior Engineers in the Conversational Engineering Department, before leaving to found Freestyle.

Freestyle is directly inspired by what they saw as their failures of the tech they worked with at Apple.
long_description.after:
Freestyle builds the most powerful VMs for AI Agents. 

- **Instant Startup**: Freestyle VMs provision in milliseconds, with p99s under 400ms.
- **Persistence**: Freestyle VMs can run forever, they can be hibernated with their exact memory in place and come back to life weeks later instantly, in that exact state.
- **Powerful**: Freestyle VMs go up to 64GB of RAM for public tiers and much further for enterprise. Freestyle does high quality hardware virtualization supporting nested virtualization, FUSE, eBPF, full Linux networking and more. If it can run in an EC2, it can run in a Freestyle VM.
- **Cheaply Snapshottable and Branchable**: Freestyle VMs are instantly and cheaply snapshottable (sub 1ms interruption, sub 50ms to snapshot ready). These snapshots can be used to create new VMs in the exact state of the original VM (memory and disk). This enables powerful workflows like branching, cloning, and rapid recovery from failures.

Sutrix turns messy EHR records into clean, study-ready datasets for hospital research teams.

Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling records, reading notes chart by chart and fixing conflicting entries in spreadsheets. Sutrix automates that work inside each hospital's own systems. It applies the study's rules and flags unclear cases for staff to review.

Paying research teams at HSS, Emory, and Mount Sinai cut data prep from 3 weeks per study to 4 days, so they start studies sooner and run more of them.

We built Sutrix because we lived this problem. Ritvik ran clinical research at HSS and Emory, and Supratik previously founded Kairo (a16z Speedrun, exited) and was an engineer at Amazon.

long_description.before:
Sona8 is a voice agent that talks to every employee about how their work gets done. Consulting, transformation and corporate development teams spend a large part of every project on stakeholder interviews and stakeholder alignment, and still only hear from a small share of the people affected.

Each employee gets a link and talks to the agent for about 20 minutes. The agent asks follow-up questions, for example why a step is still done by hand or who else is involved. From the conversations we build process maps and a list of the problems people described, by site and team.

During the implementation, the agent goes back to the employees involved after each initiative and asks whether it was implemented and what changed. The result is a project management office that has talked to every employee. Today consulting firms buy it for the stakeholder interviews at the start of an engagement. Transformation and corporate development teams buy it to run the implementation of a change program.

Over time this becomes the way a company knows how it runs. Sona8 reads the systems the company already uses, connects them to what employees said, and keeps the picture current by asking again. Before a decision, you ask what it would do across sites and teams and get an answer from the whole company. A small team steers a company-wide program that used to need a large one. And AI agents inside the company come here first to learn how the work is done before they change anything.
long_description.after:
Sona8 uses AI voice agents to interview employees about how work gets done. Consulting, transformation and corporate development teams use it to hear from more people and follow up after changes.

Employees open a link and speak in their own language. The agent asks follow-up questions, and teams compare problems across sites and departments. We’ve completed 10,000+ employee interviews and signed one of the world’s top three consulting firms.

We’re building the context layer and operating system for strategy teams: combining employee knowledge with company data to understand operations, improve processes and put decisions into action. The same context will guide AI agents as they take over work, so the company keeps what it learns.

one_liner.before: Context layer for enterprise AI surveying employees with voice agents
one_liner.after: Context layer from employee voices to improve & automate workflows
